layers.title: NASA SVS 14959 Moon 3D model, small (moon_small.glb, color map, no topography)
layers.projection: textured UV sphere, 1 mesh, 23,232 triangles; texture is a 4096x4096 cube-face cross (no polar pinch)
layers.frame: model-local: +Y north pole, longitude 0 toward -Z, east toward -X; radius about 1.278 units; not a SPICE/PCK frame
layers.attribution: NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center; NASA SVS 14959 (producer Dan Gallagher); made with LRO imagery; color source CGI Moon Kit (SVS 4720)
layers.rights: Educational/informational visualization with the NASA SVS credit "NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center"; confirm current NASA media guidance before redistribution.
layers.note: Same-origin copy for the 3D globe, written to a disk cache while its size and sha256 are checked, then streamed (never held whole in memory). Visual model only: no topography, no illumination, no visibility; not terrain data.
